gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-figtree: Open-shaped letters with no calligraphic shading give Bellota Text a commanding, distinctive face. Figtree, drawn as if with a marker tip, lets long text glide along, modern and unfussy.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-finlandica: Distinctive from the first glance, Bellota Text draws open letter shapes with no calligraphic shading to guide the eye. Large display lines suit the heading, while Finlandica stays quiet below.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-fustat: Fustat reads like bent rope, with a clear wide gap where the c ends. Bellota Text commands the top in open, unshaded shapes, and Fustat keeps paragraphs flowing without snagging.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-gantari: Bellota Text brings commanding, open-shaped letters with no calligraphic shading, a look all its own. Gantari bends like wire with wide c apertures, and that approachable friendliness is what holds the pairing together.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-gudea: Open shapes, no shading, plenty of presence from Bellota Text. Gudea, a sans with curves like drawn thread and glass-clear gaps at each terminal, keeps paragraphs approachable all the way down.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ibm-plex-sans-dev: Bellota Text is the commanding one, drawn with open shapes and no calligraphic shading. IBM Plex Sans Devanagari, with rope-loose curves that never knot at the ends, can leave the big statements to it.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ibm-plex-sans-tha: The body reads modern, its c ends pointing apart like open pincers. IBM Plex Sans Thai keeps text moving smoothly, while Bellota Text, with no hairlines at all, stays commanding up top.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-inria-sans: Bent copper pipe meets a commanding, shading-free display face. Bellota Text leads, while Inria Sans, a sans-serif of tubular strokes and see-through c openings, keeps a full page smooth to read.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-jost: Commanding open shapes up top, tidy lines below. Bellota Text drops calligraphic shading altogether, while Jost, with broad terminal gaps and a unit-width stroke, keeps paragraphs clean from top to bottom.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-jura: Open, unshaded and quietly commanding, Bellota Text sets the tone right away with distinctive letterforms. But Jura, with strokes as constant as bent wire and s curves opening wide at both ends, does the steady paragraph work.
